notes.id: Nursery, Reception. Jadwal 2026-27 masih "draft". Tarif tahunan sudah termasuk diskon 5% bayar di muka; termasuk perlengkapan. Aplikasi Rp4 juta, enrolment Rp30 juta per keluarga; makan siang Rp10 juta/term. Dihimpun Lokalfinds dari jadwal biaya resmi sekolah (Juli 2026).
notes.en: Nursery, Reception. 2026-27 schedule still marked "draft". Annual rate includes the 5% early-payment discount and supplies. Application Rp4M, enrolment Rp30M per family; lunch Rp10M/term. Compiled by Lokalfinds from the school's official fee schedule (July 2026).
